item.title: Hitozuma Isekai Senshi Natsumi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Inja no Kuruwa
  • 発売日: 2018-05-14
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 人妻異世界戦士ナツミ
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Isekai Senshi Natsumi

别名

  • A Married Warrior in the Alternate World Natsumi

あらすじ

Natsumi Takahata was just an ordinary housewife until the day she was overwhelmed

by a suddenly appeared ball of light and summoned into the alternate world.

According to a god of the world who summoned Natsumi, the world is currently

facing the risk of collapse due to the demon lord who also came inter-worldly.

item.title: Tenkishi Orc ni Kudaru.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Inja no Kuruwa
  • 発売日: 2017-08-13
  • スコア: 6.57/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天騎士オークに降る。
  • 英語名: Tenkishi Orc ni Kudaru.

别名

  • Celestial Knightess Succumbs To Orcs

あらすじ

A demonic force has arisen from below to conquer the human race.

Since human society was exhausted due to the civil war, they were helpless against the evil hordes…

Opposed to the heaven’s policy of non-intervention, a legion of celestial world comes down to assist humanity.

item.title: Ryoujoku Toujou - Maketara Ryoujoku Namachuukei! Hamerareta JK Kakutouka
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Inja no Kuruwa
  • 発売日: 2017-03-26
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 凌辱闘場 負けたら凌辱生中継! ハメられたJK格闘家
  • 英語名: Ryoujoku Toujou - Maketara Ryoujoku Namachuukei! Hamerareta JK Kakutouka

あらすじ

Rinko, a JK at the local highschool, is a real strong karate girl.

She won the national karate contest this year and is now looking for a new challenge.

One day, one of the members in her club gives her a flier with information about an underground martial arts tournament and she is totally interested!
